scenes.text: The station closed in 1957. The tracks were lifted in 1962.
But at 3 AM, the platform lights still come on.
The timetable board still shows one departure.
It has no destination listed. Only a time.
3 AM. Every night. For sixty years.
Follow for more Quiet Horror Files.
